name: SPIRIT-3 Portable Oxygen Concentrator
description: Portable oxygen concentrator for active, on-the-go use. Up to 5 hours of battery use, 4 pulse settings, operating noise of 55 dB(A) or less. Rechargeable battery plus AC and vehicle DC power; simple controls with battery display; low-oxygen, no-breath and low-battery alerts. Approx. weight 4.9 lb; size 8.72 x 4.22 x 8.87 in; max outlet pressure 150 kPa. Includes battery, AC supply, DC cable, cannulas, carry bag and manual.

name: YE660E Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor
description: Upper-arm blood pressure monitor with voice broadcast, large LCD, 99 memories and irregular heartbeat indication.

name: YE620B Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor
description: Upper-arm blood pressure monitor with voice broadcast, large backlit LCD and a 22-45 cm cuff. AC adapter included.

name: YE680B Upper Arm Blood Pressure Monitor
description: Upper-arm blood pressure monitor with voice broadcast, large backlit LCD, 2-user memory and an average-of-3-readings mode. Bluetooth option available.

name: YE8800AR Wrist Blood Pressure Monitor with Bluetooth
description: Compact wrist blood pressure monitor with Bluetooth, rechargeable lithium battery and USB Type-C charging.

name: YT-1 Infrared Thermometer
description: Touch-free infrared thermometer with rapid measurement. Includes hard case and 2 x AAA batteries.

name: YHT101 Infrared Ear Thermometer
description: Infrared ear thermometer with rapid ear measurement. Disposable probe covers, hard case and 2 x AAA batteries included.

name: YX103 Finger Pulse Oximeter
description: Finger pulse oximeter with a high-visibility red LED display for fast, accurate readings. Includes lanyard.

name: YX306 Finger Pulse Oximeter
description: Finger pulse oximeter with an easy-to-read OLED display, auto-rotate and pulse wave display. Includes lanyard and carry bag.
